name: Schemathesis OpenAPI contract testing
short_definition: Property-based and conformance testing of HTTP APIs from the OpenAPI document: Schemathesis 4.x generates examples, fuzz inputs, coverage cases, and optional stateful chains, then validates responses against the schema — catching 500s, schema drift, and edge cases hand-written pytest misses.
scope_in: Schemathesis CLI and pytest integration; OpenAPI 3.x from FastAPI (from_asgi / exported JSON); checks (status, response schema, content-type); phases (examples, fuzzing, coverage, stateful); auth headers for protected routes; CI job patterns; relationship to hand-written tests and consumer-driven contracts.
scope_out: Unit/fixture design (py-testing); full CI matrix (py-ci-gates); GraphQL-only deep dive unless using Schemathesis GraphQL mode; Pact broker enterprise setup as default; load testing/k6.
defaults: For FastAPI services: generate/export OpenAPI as source of truth (app.openapi() or /openapi.json). Prefer in-process testing via schemathesis.openapi.from_asgi("/openapi.json", app) in pytest for speed and no port binding; use CLI `uvx schemathesis run <schema> -u <base>` against ephemeral compose stack for staging-like runs. Enable core checks (defaults in v4 run all available checks). Start with examples+fuzzing phases; add stateful when OpenAPI links exist for write→read flows. Authenticate test client with test JWTs/API keys via headers or hooks — never skip auth by disabling middleware globally in a way that diverges from prod. Keep Schemathesis in dev/CI dependency-group, not runtime. Fail CI on new server errors and response_schema_conformance violations; triage flaky health-checks carefully.
decision_gates: USE Schemathesis: any public or BFF-facing OpenAPI service, especially FastAPI. USE pytest integration: local/CI without network. USE CLI against running service: multi-language APIs (Go/Rust) with published OpenAPI. USE Pact/consumer-driven: when multiple consumer teams need independent deploy contracts beyond provider schema fuzz. SKIP heavy stateful fuzz on every PR if slow — nightly + examples/coverage on PR. DO NOT treat Schemathesis as replacement for authz unit tests or business-rule tests. DO NOT run destructive stateful tests against shared staging without isolation.
do_dont: DO: keep OpenAPI accurate (response_model, status codes); pin schemathesis; record curl reproducers from failures; exclude truly unsafe ops (DELETE all) via include/exclude filters; seed DB for required fixtures. DON'T: hand-edit generated OpenAPI out of band as only source; ignore schema failures as 'noise'; use discontinued Schemathesis.io SaaS flags from v3 guides; pass production tokens in CI logs; fuzz unlimited on paid third-party APIs.
code_skeleton:
# tests/contract/test_openapi.py
import pytest
import schemathesis
from svc_api.main import create_app

app = create_app()
schema = schemathesis.openapi.from_asgi("/openapi.json", app)

@schema.parametrize()
def test_api(case):
    # Optional: case.headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {test_token}"}
    case.call_and_validate()

# Fixture-based (DB-backed app)
# schema = schemathesis.pytest.from_fixture("api_schema")

# CLI (v4)
# uvx schemathesis run ./openapi.json -u http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
#   --checks all \
#   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
#   --phases examples,fuzzing,coverage \
#   --max-examples 100

# GitHub Action option:
# - uses: schemathesis/action@v3  # pin SHA in real templates
#   with:
#     schema: "http://localhost:8000/openapi.json"
#     base-url: "http://localhost:8000"
failure_modes: 1) Incomplete OpenAPI (missing response models) → false confidence. 2) Auth not applied → only public routes tested. 3) Stateful tests corrupt shared DB. 4) v3 CLI flags copied into v4 (removed --base-url style, Schemathesis.io options) → broken CI. 5) Flaky over-strict checks on undocumented error bodies. 6) Rate limits / WAF block fuzzer. 7) from_asgi app missing lifespan resources → false 500s.
anti_patterns: Agents must not: invent v3-only APIs (schemathesis.from_asgi top-level without openapi namespace); recommend Schemathesis.io upload; disable all checks to go green; replace unit tests with fuzz only; commit production bearer tokens; run unbounded fuzz in PR without max-examples; claim GraphQL coverage without configuring GraphQL schema source.
tools: Primary: Schemathesis 4.x (Hypothesis-powered). Complementary: openapi-spec-validator / spectral for static schema lint; schemathesis pytest plugin; optional Pact for consumer-driven. Alternatives: Dredd (aging), Postman monitors, manual httpx golden tests — weaker property coverage.
versions_as_of: as_of 2026-07-13 — Schemathesis 4.22.4 on PyPI; Hypothesis 6.156.x typically co-installed. v4 is a major rewrite (CLI phases, openapi.* loaders, Schemathesis.io removed). Prefer docs.schemathesis.io migration guide when updating from 3.x. OpenAPI 3.0/3.1/3.2 supported per project docs.

deprecation_watch: Schemathesis v3 Python API (schemathesis.from_uri, from_asgi at top level); Schemathesis.io token/upload flags; --app CLI option; aiohttp loader; treating experimental flags still required; Dredd as greenfield default; hand-maintained Postman collections as only contract test.
ts_boundary: Next/TS BFF should consume the same OpenAPI (codegen zod/types). Run Schemathesis against Python provider; optional TS consumer tests assert client types match. Do not re-specify the contract twice by hand. When BFF aggregates APIs, contract-test the public BFF schema separately.
rust_boundary: Rust services exporting OpenAPI can be targeted by Schemathesis CLI the same way (language-agnostic). Prefer schema export from utoipa/etc. Property tests inside Rust (proptest) remain for pure functions; Schemathesis for HTTP surface.
supabase_boundary: Supabase REST/GraphQL is a separate contract — do not expect Schemathesis on FastAPI to validate Supabase RLS. If Python wraps Supabase, test your facade's OpenAPI; use dedicated tests for RLS policies.
boundary_contracts: OpenAPI document is the shared contract artifact (committed export or generated in CI from app). JSON Schema for events if async. Env for test auth only. MCP tools: separate schema — do not assume OpenAPI fuzz covers MCP.
decision_matrix_row: Problem: API implements its own OpenAPI → Schemathesis provider tests. Problem: multi-consumer independent deploys → consider Pact + Schemathesis. Problem: pure domain → pytest unit. Problem: TS UI → Playwright. Problem: schema static lint only → spectral/redocly, still add Schemathesis for runtime.
threats: Fuzzer triggers expensive side effects (sends email, moves money) on unprotected ops; secrets in Authorization headers printed in reports; SSRF-like generated URLs if API fetches user URLs; DoS against shared environments.
mitigations: Exclude unsafe operations; use dedicated test env and accounts; sanitize reports (output sanitize options); cap examples; no prod base URL; rate-limit test app; review OpenAPI for dangerous ops before enabling stateful.
agent_codegen_policy: MUST: Schemathesis v4 openapi.from_asgi or CLI against exported schema for FastAPI services with public OpenAPI; auth headers for protected routes; CI job or marked pytest. MUST NOT: v3-only APIs; Schemathesis.io; disable checks wholesale; store prod tokens; skip response models then claim contract coverage.
tests_required: Contract job: Schemathesis parametrize or CLI; retain unit/integration for business rules. Optional nightly higher max-examples + stateful. Static OpenAPI lint optional companion.
ci_gates: PR: examples/coverage or moderate max-examples fuzz on ASGI; fail on not_a_server_error + response_schema_conformance. Nightly: longer fuzz + stateful. Artifact: junit/HAR on failure.
skill_scan_signals: POSITIVE: tests/contract or schemathesis in CI; from_asgi / openapi.json tested; response_model on routes. NEGATIVE: OpenAPI untested; v3-only config; docs disabled and no exported schema; only happy-path pytest for API; production URL in contract job.
skill_module_bullets: Schemathesis 4.x is the default OpenAPI contract/fuzz tool for Python APIs.
Prefer schemathesis.openapi.from_asgi for FastAPI in pytest; CLI for running services.
v4 loaders live under schemathesis.openapi.* — do not copy v3 APIs.
Auth headers required for protected routes; exclude destructive ops from automated fuzz.
Contract tests complement, not replace, unit and integration tests.
Export or serve accurate OpenAPI (response_model) or checks are meaningless.
action_items: Add Schemathesis v4 snippet to references/python.md.
Scan for untested OpenAPI / missing response_model.
Document v3→v4 migration pitfalls for agents.
checklist: Unsafe ops excluded or isolated env
CI fails on server error + schema conformance
conflicts_noted: Older tutorials (incl. Docker Schemathesis.io tokens) are obsolete after Schemathesis.io discontinuation and v4 CLI redesign. pytest plugin patterns evolved (pytest.from_fixture). How aggressive PR vs nightly fuzz is team-specific — default moderate PR budget. Pact vs Schemathesis: different problems (consumer-driven vs provider property testing); can coexist.
